name: 未测之海 · 深渊之眼
purpose: Application icon design; not yet assigned to Unity PlayerSettings.
concept: 海浪构成眼睛，调查船作为瞳孔，黄铜航海仪器围环；表现探知与被注视。
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final standalone square application icon for the original game THE UNSOUNDED SEA (未测之海), a maritime gothic investigative card roguelike.
Create ONE exquisitely designed, visually memorable icon, full-bleed square artwork, no mockup or presentation board. The core emblem is an abyssal eye formed by two bold curling ocean-wave silhouettes, enclosed within a weathered brass nautical instrument ring. Inside the eye's dark center is ONE small ivory silhouette of an early twentieth-century investigation vessel seen from its bow, its mast pointing upwards: the ship becomes the eye's pupil. An elegant integrated symbol, immediately readable, not a busy narrative painting. The dark negative space beneath the vessel suggests unmeasurable ocean depth. Unsettling and dignified, nautical investigation, fragile human curiosity confronted by a vast unknown.
Style: premium art-directed game identity, strong graphic silhouettes with restrained copperplate engraving and worn metal finish, three-dimensional brass relief only subtly suggested. Near-symmetrical emblem, a little organic asymmetry in waves. Main emblem fills 78 percent of the square; generous safe margins for OS rounded corner crops; continuous dark background to every edge; no baked outer rounded corners. Very strong silhouette readable at 64 pixels, broad wave forms, minimal fine ornament, no tiny text or compass letters.
Palette: deep ocean black-teal #081316 background, antique brass #d7bd82 and #9e8755 ring and wave edges, pale ivory #eee4c9 ship, muted sea green #80b5a5 accents. Dark background with an extremely subtle radial depth, crisp warmly lit emblem.
Text: none. Avoid letters, title, typography, watermarks, extra badges, skulls, tentacle clutter, realistic eyeball flesh, pirate imagery, islands, lighthouses, excessive neon, lens flares, ornate filigree, photorealistic ocean scenes. Deliver polished finished artwork, not a sketch.
notes: Opaque square artwork; platform masks may be applied externally.
Raster source generated by Canva; no vector master.
Fine engraving and ship details simplify at small sizes.
